objective: Eliminate avoidable distribution bottlenecks by composing discovery, enrichment, journey orchestration, sender infrastructure, owned content and governed channel execution into one attribution/economic graph.
economicNorthStar: risk-adjusted cleared contribution profit per founder minute
architectureLaw: Absorb mechanisms into existing canonical systems. Do not build disconnected SaaS clones or duplicate workflow, CRM, payment-truth, scheduler, suppression, or outbound engines.

capabilities.nextMissingCapability: Authenticated provider adapters plus cost/coverage benchmarking and cache/reconciliation receipts.
capabilities.truthBoundary: Provider result is evidence, not permission, consent, demand or revenue. Private contact data may not be guessed.

capabilities.nextMissingCapability: Complete and merge the bounded public-evidence partner universe for the selected white-label canary.
capabilities.truthBoundary: Directory presence is not demand or contact permission.

capabilities.nextMissingCapability: Plan-only journey occurrence expansion into the canonical scheduler with per-profile frequency state and conversion attribution.
capabilities.truthBoundary: Journey compilation creates no communication authority.

capabilities.nextMissingCapability: Feed real authenticated domain/IP reputation, capacity and warm-up observations into allocation once provider infrastructure is authorized.
capabilities.truthBoundary: No identity, domain or IP rotation to evade reputation, blocks, quotas, complaints, suppression or provider enforcement.

capabilities.nextMissingCapability: Provider-specific official/authorized publication and analytics adapters; human handoff where platform APIs do not authorize the requested action.
capabilities.truthBoundary: No scraping or browser bots used to automate LinkedIn connections, DMs, likes, comments or other actions contrary to platform rules.

capabilities.nextMissingCapability: Evidence-bound content brief compiler producing SEO/AEO briefs, technical remediation packets, social variants and video-script briefs from source-backed evidence without auto-publishing.
capabilities.truthBoundary: No scaled low-value content, fabricated case evidence, fabricated revenue claims or uncontrolled auto-publication.
